entries.note: Research priorities are public, but whether researchers privately care about natural intelligence cannot be settled by them.

entries.test: Public evaluations of the named systems available in May 2022 would show whether careful examination distinguished their capabilities from human intelligence.
entries.note: The plain contextual reading concerns distinguishable capabilities, rather than a literal census of every observer.
“Something is deeply amiss” supplies no shared criterion beyond the errors themselves.

entries.test: Published capabilities and evaluations of scaled AI systems as of May 14, 2022 would establish whether scaling had achieved human-level general intelligence.
entries.note: Context makes “worked” mean achieving general intelligence, not producing any useful results. Future success is entertained as a possibility.

entries.test: Public investment reports, model and dataset specifications, and research from 1988 through May 2022 would establish the claimed spending, growth, and persistence of comprehension errors.
entries.note: These are historical factual assertions, including the stated dataset units.

entries.test: Published arguments by neural-network advocates and evaluations of leading systems on compositional descriptions by May 2022 would establish both assertions.
entries.note: “Elude” means failure to handle such descriptions reliably, consistent with the examples.

Marcus judges the justification of Sutton’s extrapolation; he does not forecast that data and compute will cease driving advances. The normalization weakens Sutton’s position to mere continued contribution.

entries.test: Public comparisons of pure deep-learning or big-data systems available in May 2022 with Flash Fill on one-example spreadsheet transformations would establish whether any matched its capabilities.
entries.note: In context this is a present capability claim; “I don’t think” introduces his asserted assessment.

entries.test: The named researchers’ published problem statements and public AI results through May 2022 would show whether virtually all those problems remained unsolved.
entries.note: The following text anchors the claim in general comprehension and reasoning capabilities.

entries.test: Fodor’s and Pinker’s 1988 articles compared with documented AI failures through May 2022 would establish whether the listed failure modes persisted.
entries.note: The passage mixes a logical point and evaluative language with a checkable historical assertion. “Have not changed” refers to the categories of failures, not identical performance.
The central commitment is that Gato’s limitations should give researchers pause.

entries.test: A publicly documented AGI achievement and its development methods would show whether it required insights from human reasoning, world understanding, language, and concept learning.
entries.note: This asserts a necessary ingredient for achieving AGI, with no deadline. Learning from humans is the predicted requirement, not an additional antecedent.
“Sheer hubris” evaluates the opposing belief rather than supplying an empirical test.
